This is original audio for a cozy dark-fantasy comedy, 2D quarter-view castle-defense game. It must be new material, not an imitation of any artist, franchise, existing song, or copyrighted melody.

Compose an original instrumental game soundtrack lasting about 128 seconds. 96 BPM, C Dorian. A lovable demon ruler straightening a crooked banner. Oboe and mandolin answer each other over short light tuba notes and brushed snare, a buoyant offbeat miniature march rather than a solemn overture. Develop a complete original 128-second instrumental arc, with compatible opening and final two seconds for a seamless loop. Keep the arrangement readable under frequent combat sound effects. No vocals, spoken words, choir syllables, or recognizable samples. Build a coherent arc without a hard ending. Keep the opening and final two seconds texturally compatible so they can be crossfaded into a seamless loop.
